verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service, so asking whether it offers official SDKs is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows an Atlas-specific SDK or API. The llms.txt probe mentions Stripe packages generally, which is a capability of the broader Stripe platform rather than Atlas, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
